<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>UPI Fee Controversy:</strong> The Congress party has criticized the government over reports of a 0.4% fee on UPI transactions, prompting a sharp rebuttal from the BJP, while MPs have raised concerns about the issue during a parliamentary panel meeting.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Disability Pension Ruling:</strong> The Supreme Court dismissed 271 appeals by the Centre against ex-servicemen, ruling that disability pension benefits must be granted in cases of doubt and that the government bears the burden of disproving the link between a disability and military service.</li>
</ul>
